questions.question: The value of [12 × 5 - {200 - (501 + 247 - 386)}] ÷ 2 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

1. Solve inner parenthesis: 501 + 247 − 386 = 362.

2. Solve middle braces: 200 − 362 = −162.

3. Solve square brackets: (12 × 5) − (−162) = 60 + 162 = 222.

4. Final calculation: 222 ÷ 2 = 111.

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: [12 × 5 − {200 − (501 + 247 − 386)}] ÷ 2

Formula Used: BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ [12 × 5 − {200 − (748 − 386)}] ÷ 2

⇒ [60 − {200 − 362}] ÷ 2

⇒ [60 − (−162)] ÷ 2

⇒ [60 + 162] ÷ 2

⇒ 222 ÷ 2

⇒ 111

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Priority

BODMAS ensures the correct sequence: Brackets, Orders (indices), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Bracket Hierarchy

Always solve in the order: Parentheses ( ), then Curly braces { }, and finally Square brackets [ ].

Sign Rules

Subtracting a negative number is equivalent to adding its positive value: a − (−b) = a + b.</p

questions.question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 36 cm. What is the area of this triangle?
questions.solution:
Given:

The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 36 cm.

Concept used:

1. An equilateral triangle is a triangle that has all its sides equal in length.

2. The perimeter of an equilateral triangle equals three times the measure of each side.

3. Area of an equilateral triangle = √3/4 × (Side)²

Calculation:

The measure of each side = 36/3 = 12 cm

Now, the area of the triangle = √3/4 × 12² = 36√ 3 cm2

**∴ The area of this triangle is 36sqrt 3 cm2.**

questions.question: A can do a work in 10 days and B can do the same work in 15 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A can do a work in 10 days and B can do the same work in 15 days.

Concept used:

If A and B take x and y days to complete a task independently, alone they will get the work done in = xy/(x + y) days

Calculation:

Working together they can complete the work in

⇒ (10 × 15)/(10 + 15)

⇒ 6 days

In 6 days, 100% of the work is done.

In 4 days, the work will be done

⇒ (100/6 × 4)%

⇒ 400/600

⇒ 2/3 fraction of the original work

Now, the fraction of the work that is left = 1 - 2/3 = 1/3

∴ The fraction of the work that is left is (1)/(3).

questions.question: The average of 11 observations is 10, that of the first 6 being 9 and that of the last 6 being 11. What is the 6th observation?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 11 observations is 10, that of the first 6 being 9 and that of the last 6 being 11.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

Sum of 11 observations = 11 × 10 = 110

Sum of the first 6 observations = 6 × 9 = 54

Sum of the last 6 observations = 6 × 11 = 66

Now, the 6th observation = (54 + 66 - 110) = 10

**∴ The 6th observation is 10.**

questions.question: The diagonal of a rectangle is 12 cm long, and it is twice as long as one of the sides of the rectangle. What is the area of this rectangle?
questions.solution:
Given:

The diagonal of a rectangle is 12 cm long, and it is twice as long as one of the sides of the rectangle.

Concept used:

1. Area of a rectangle = Length × Breadth

2. Measure of each diagonal of a rectangle = sqrt {Length² + Breadth²}

Calculation:

Measure of one side of the rectangle = 12/2 = 6 cm

Let the measure of the other side of the rectangle be Q cm.

According to the concept,

sqrt {Q² + 6²} = 12²

⇒ Q² + 36 = 144

⇒ Q² = 108

⇒ Q = 6√3

Now, the area of the rectangle = 6 × 6√3 = 36√3 cm²

**∴ The area of the rectangle is 36√3 cm2.**

questions.question: 4 boys or 7 girls can complete a piece of work in 18 days. How many days will 12 boys and 21 girls together take to complete this job?
questions.solution:
Given:

4 boys or 7 girls can complete a piece of work in 18 days. 

Concept used:

Total work = Number of workers × Efficiency of each worker × Days to complete the work

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of each boy and girl be B and G respectively.

According to the concept,

4B = 7G

⇒ B/G = 7/4

So, the efficiencies of each boy and girl be 7k and 4k respectively. (k = constant)

Total work = (4 × 7k × 18) units

Now, to complete the job, 12 boys and 21 girls together will take

⇒ (4 × 7k × 18) ÷ (12 × 7k + 21 × 4k)

⇒ 3 days

**∴ 12 boys and 21 girls together will take 3 days to complete this job.**

questions.question: The number of boys in a class is 45% of the total number of students in the class. If the number of girls in the class is 33, then what is the number of boys in the class?
questions.solution:
Given:

The number of boys in a class is 45% of the total number of students in the class. 

The number of girls in the class is 33.

Calculation:

Percentage of the girls = 100 - 45 = 55%

So, the total number of students in the class = 33 ÷ 55% = 60

Now, the number of boys in the class = 60 × 45% = 27

**∴ The number of boys in the class is 27.**

questions.question: A : B = 12 : 17 and A is 20% more than C. If B is 15% less than D, then C is what percentage of D?
questions.solution:
Given:

A : B = 12 : 17

A is 20% more than C. 

B is 15% less than D.

Concept used:

Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation:

Let, A = 12 and B = 17

So,

C = 12/(1 + 20%) = 10

D = 17/(1 - 15%) = 20

Now, the required percentage = 10/20 × 100% = 50%

∴ C is 50% of D.

questions.question: Raju sells an object at 20% below its cost price. If he sold it for Rs. 450 more, he would have made a profit of 25%. What is the original selling price of the object?
questions.solution:
Given:

Raju sells an object at 20% below its cost price.

If he sold it for Rs. 450 more, he would have made a profit of 25%.

Concept used:

1. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)

2. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%)

Calculation:

Let the cost price of the product be Q.

According to the concept,

Q(1 - 20%) + 450 = Q(1 + 25%)

⇒ 1.25Q - 0.8Q = 450

⇒ 0.45Q = 450

⇒ Q = 450/0.45

⇒ Q = 1000

Now, the original selling price = 1000(1 - 20%) = Rs. 800

∴ The original selling price of the product is Rs. 800.
